run_pipeline_generate_video: run the SkyReelsV2DiffusionForcingImageToVideoPipeline to generate a video from an image and text prompt
run_pipeline_long_video: run the pipeline with overlap_history to generate long videos exceeding base_num_frames using sliding window
run_pipeline_async_inference: run the pipeline with ar_step>0 to enable asynchronous diffusion forcing for better temporal consistency
run_pipeline_add_noise_condition: run the pipeline with addnoise_condition to smooth long video generation by adding noise to clean conditions
run_pipeline_generate_latents: run the pipeline with output_type=latent to return raw latent tensors instead of decoded video frames
